tasks.title: Setup Research Framework
tasks.description: Establish a systematic research methodology for analyzing the SmartMarketOOPS implementation.
tasks.details: Create a structured research plan with clear objectives, methodologies, and deliverables. Use tools like JIRA or Trello for task tracking. Document the research process in a shared repository (e.g., GitHub Wiki).
tasks.testStrategy: Validate the research framework by reviewing it with stakeholders and ensuring all research objectives are covered.

tasks.title: Analyze Trade Execution Workflows
tasks.description: Review and document the current trade entry and exit mechanisms in the DeltaTradingBot.
tasks.details: Examine the DeltaTradingBot codebase to understand trade execution logic. Use logging and debugging tools to trace trade flows. Document success rates and bottlenecks.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate trade scenarios to validate execution workflows and identify failures.

tasks.title: Audit ML Model Integration
tasks.description: Assess the current utilization of ML models (LSTM, Transformer, ensemble systems) in trading decisions.
tasks.details: Review advanced_ml_intelligence.py and related files. Analyze how predictions are translated into trading actions. Evaluate model accuracy and performance.
tasks.testStrategy: Run ML models on historical data to validate prediction accuracy and decision-making impact.

tasks.title: Evaluate Analysis Engine Components
tasks.description: Assess the functionality and performance of the 4-tier timeframe analysis and other analysis components.
tasks.details: Review the analysis engine codebase. Test candle formation, momentum train detection, and confluence scoring. Document accuracy and reliability.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate analysis outputs against historical market data to ensure accuracy.

tasks.title: Review Execution Infrastructure
tasks.description: Investigate the Delta Exchange API integration and order management system.
tasks.details: Examine API integration code and order management workflows. Assess risk management and error handling mechanisms.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate order placements and cancellations to test reliability and error recovery.

tasks.title: Identify Integration Gaps
tasks.description: Document missing connections between analysis and execution components.
tasks.details: Map data flows between ML models, analysis engine, and execution system. Identify synchronization and coordination issues.
tasks.testStrategy: Trace data paths and validate real-time coordination between components.

tasks.title: Test Trade Execution Performance
tasks.description: Measure latency and reliability of trade execution workflows.
tasks.details: Use performance monitoring tools to measure execution times and failure rates. Document bottlenecks.
tasks.testStrategy: Run stress tests to evaluate system performance under high load.

tasks.title: Validate ML Model Performance
tasks.description: Assess the accuracy and speed of ML model predictions.
tasks.details: Benchmark model inference times and prediction accuracy against test datasets.
tasks.testStrategy: Compare model outputs with actual market movements to validate accuracy.

tasks.title: Assess Analysis Engine Speed
tasks.description: Evaluate the responsiveness and accuracy of the analysis engine.
tasks.details: Measure signal generation times and compare with market data. Document delays.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate analysis outputs in real-time trading scenarios.

tasks.title: Document System Architecture
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive overview of the current system architecture.
tasks.details: Diagram component interactions and data flows. Highlight integration gaps and bottlenecks.
tasks.testStrategy: Review the architecture documentation with the development team for accuracy.

tasks.title: Prioritize Improvement Opportunities
tasks.description: Identify and rank critical gaps and performance issues.
tasks.details: Use a scoring system to prioritize gaps based on impact and feasibility.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate prioritization with stakeholders and domain experts.

tasks.title: Develop Implementation Roadmap
tasks.description: Create a detailed plan for addressing identified gaps and improvements.
tasks.details: Outline tasks, timelines, and resources required for implementation. Include risk mitigation strategies.
tasks.testStrategy: Review the roadmap with stakeholders to ensure feasibility and alignment with goals.
